summary:
Chartered Accountant with strong academic background and practical exposure gained through extensive articleship experience in
areas such as auditing, taxation, and financial reporting. Skilled in handling statutory audits, GST returns, TDS filings, and preparation
of financial statements in compliance with applicable laws and accounting standards.A quick learner with strong analytical and
problem-solving skills, ready to contribute effectively in dynamic business environments.

bullets: Analyzed financial statements for accuracy, compliance with Ind AS, and disclosure requirements.
Prepared audit deliverables including audit reports, financial schedules, and management letters.
Tax Audit (Section 44AB – Income Tax Act): Conducted comprehensive tax audits including validation of Form 3CD clauses, revenue recognition, TDS compliance, and expense verification.
Identified tax exposure areas, supported tax planning, and ensured timely filing of audit reports.
Coordinated with clients for ledger scrutiny, documentation, and clarification of tax positions.
Direct & Indirect Tax Compliance: Assisted in preparation and review of Income Tax Returns for corporates, partnerships, and individuals.
Managed GST assignments including return filing (GSTR-1, 3B, 9), input-output reconciliation, and responding to GST notices.
Monitored deadlines to ensure zero delays in statutory compliance.
Client Management & Stakeholder Communication: Served as primary point of contact for clients, ensuring smooth coordination during audits and assessments.
Led statutory audits for diverse clients in industries such as manufacturing, banking, and healthcare, ensuring compliance with Indian GAAP and IFRS.
Performed internal audits to identify operational inefficiencies and risks, delivering actionable recommendations that enhanced client processes.
Prepared and reviewed financial statements in compliance with Ind AS, Companies Act, and applicable tax laws.
Ensured timely filing of ROC returns, Income Tax returns, GST returns, and other statutory filings.
Ensured compliance with the MSMED act 2006, including calculation and timely reporting of interest due to MSME vendors, aligning with the provisions of the MSMED Act.
